Victim ID ACME-7Q2-0451, ransom demand 4.2 BTC via lockstar-support@ransom.example with 72-hour deadline and threats to publish payroll and patient data. Ransom note (README_RESTORE_FILES.txt) instructs email within 72 hours and not to modify encrypted files. Two containment proposals were submitted and rejected by the commander: (1) isolate host acme-fs from network, (2) disable backup user account.
